Anima Ability @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.spells.Item.VVyNdCiStJz5GUhT]{Anima Ability: Wave of Truth}

You unleash a light of revelation in an area. Creatures in the area must make a Reflex save or be emblazoned with light. Against creatures affected with this light, you and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to Seek checks and Recall Knowledge checks and double the bonus to their damage rolls.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is lit for 1 round.

Failure The creature is lit for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature emits a 10-foot radius of dim light and 5-foot radius of bright light. They suffer a -2 status penalty to Stealth checks and if they are invisible, they become only hidden for the duration.
